source_evidence: Direct visual examples TAV-02A/TAV-034A/TAV-05A plus user-qualified historical drafting semantics confirmed 2026-08-24
observed_drafting_behavior: When two support-number sequences are written/stacked on one reinforcement drawing, the sequences identify homologous travate represented by the same graphical scheme. Corresponding labels such as 4/5 are homologous stations of the two travate, not an implicit transverse beam 4-5.
allowed_use: Use this semantic rule to interpret stacked/paired labels and to exclude transverse cross-links from a longitudinal paired-run armature scope unless the cross-link is explicitly drawn or separately called out.
forbidden_use: Do not promote the user's semantic explanation itself to DOC and do not infer a cross-link armature from the homologous longitudinal scheme.
validation_requirement: Apply only where the primary drawing visibly contains paired/stacked support sequences and carpenteria independently confirms the physical topology.
note: This resolves the semantic ambiguity of 4/5, 3/6, 2/7-style stacked labels while preserving source facts separately from the qualified interpretation.
